names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 3 mai, «Sfântul Mucenic Diodor».
Read out of saint.gr's line for 3 Μαΐου, «Άγιοι Διόδωρος και Ροδοπιανός ο Διάκονος», with the rank word left off.

The heading of days.pravoslavie.ru's name page 606, «Диодор Афродисийский (Карийский), мч.», with the rank word left off and the parenthesis left out of the form. THE PARENTHESIS HERE IS NOT A SURNAME but a second toponymic — «Карийский», of Caria, the province Aphrodisias stood in — which the calendar prints as an alternative and which is recorded here rather than stored. The day's own line declines the forename alone. The bare «Диодор» would reach nine Diodorus folders in this corpus, which is why the toponymic is kept: measured against the gate's own key function, 'афродисиискии диодор' has no other holder.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 29 апреля ст. ст. — «Мчч. Диодора и Родопиана диакона (284-305).»

attestations.note: The day's fourth entry of eight, one line naming two men, with a name link each and both pointing at one life page, life953. `day-candidates.mjs` DID NOT LIST EITHER OF THEM, because this corpus keeps both on the menologion's 3 May, where the Greek and Romanian calendars have them, and the scan asks only about 29/4; they were found by `ls -d saints/*diodor*` and `ls -d saints/*rodopian*`, which is the check BRIEF-RUSSIAN §5 names for a folder standing on a different menologion day. THEY ARE THE SAME TWO MEN: the folder's `related` already pairs him with `rodopianus`, and life953 is four lines long and says the same four things saint.gr says — a Diodorus and a Rhodopianus who was a deacon, under Diocletian, at Aphrodisias in Caria, stoned for spreading the faith among the heathen. HIS `dates` DID NOT MOVE: the folder holds a flat 302 off saint.gr's «(302 μ.Χ.)», and this line gives only the reign, «(284-305)», which is wider and not narrower. Widening to the whole reign would displace a year that was read. The day page prints no hymn under either name.

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 3 mai — «Sfântul Mucenic Diodor»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 3ης Μαΐου — «Άγιοι Διόδωρος και Ροδοπιανός ο Διάκονος»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 3 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day the Romanian calendar keeps him, and it pairs him with the deacon Rodopianus exactly as doxologia does, which is what makes him the same man. **The Greek adds the year and the place**: «Οι Άγιοι αυτοί έζησαν στα χρόνια του βασιλιά Διοκλητιανού (302 μ.Χ.)» and the soldiers of «της πόλης Αφροδισίας της Καριάς», the city of Aphrodisias in Caria, of which it gives its own gloss — the region of Asia Minor occupying its south-western corner, opposite the stretch between Samos and Rhodes. **The year 302 is now in `dates`**, and it is the page's only year; it is printed as the date of Diocletian's reign rather than of the martyrdom, and the note says so rather than claiming more. **The `related` row to Rodopianus is new** and rests on the page naming the two of them in one line and one sentence. It prints no hymn and names no relic.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (20 September 2026).

death.note: saint.gr: «Οι Άγιοι αυτοί έζησαν στα χρόνια του βασιλιά Διοκλητιανού (302 μ.Χ.) και ... Τελικά λιθοβολήθηκαν». The page prints 302 as the year of the reign it places them in and gives no separate year for the stoning; nothing narrower is claimed here.
